Name: Seasonal Vanilla Buildings
Author: magimatica
Description:
[b]Update 3/1/21: I'm afraid this mod is very out of date, and by now someone else has done it better, so instead of updating mine, I instead recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6330]Elle's Seasonal Vanilla Buildings[/url]![/b]

The basic buildings, with small tweaks and seasonal elements for use with Seasonal Immersion mod. Intended to match well with vanilla game. As always please let me know if you encounter any stray pixels or similar.

***THIS IS A CONTENT PACK INTENDED FOR USE WITH THE [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/resources/smapi-seasonal-immersion.4262/updates]SEASONAL IMMERSION MOD[/url], PLEASE MAKE SURE YOU HAVE INSTALLED IT FIRST*****

New to modding? Please read [url=http://canimod.com/for-players/intro]here[/url] for help.

Now repackaged with hopefully helpful installation guide.

Update 8/12/19: ailer has combined some of the assets from this mod with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/5575844]Lumisteria Buildings[/url] to make [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4318?tab=description]Lumisteria Buildings with seasonal elements[/url]﻿, check it out!
